name: Ibn Sina completes the Canon of Medicine
summary: Avicenna (Ibn Sina) completes Al-Qanun fi al-Tibb, a five-volume synthesis of Galenic, Aristotelian, and Islamic medical knowledge. Translated into Latin in the 12th century, it remains the standard European medical textbook until the 17th century.

_quarry.structural_significance: Standard medical curriculum text of both the Islamic world and Latin Christendom for ~500 years; carries Greek medical knowledge into medieval universities.
